```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)
hc_set_theme("hcrt", tooltip = list(valueDecimals = 2))
```

## Basic charts

The original gallery starts from one colorful table and changes the series type.
Polar charts stay in the same list. The additional types below are available in
the shared bundle; no separate module download is needed. The [Maps](maps.html)
and [Stock](stock.html) articles cover geographic and financial series.

```{r common-data}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

set.seed(123)
n <- 6
colors <- c("#d35400", "#2980b9", "#2ecc71", "#f1c40f", "#2c3e50", "#7f8c8d")
colors2 <- c("#000004", "#3B0F70", "#8C2981", "#DE4968", "#FE9F6D", "#FCFDBF")

df <- tibble(x = seq_len(n) - 1) |>
  mutate(
    y = 10 + x + 10 * sin(x - 1),
    z = 5 + x * y - median(x * y),
    e = round(10 * abs(rnorm(n)) + 2, 1),
    low = y - e,
    high = y + e,
    value = round(y - 1),
    name = sample(fruit[str_length(fruit) <= 5], n),
    color = colors,
    label = name,
    xlow = x - 0.3,
    xhigh = x + 0.3
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) |>
  select(-e) |>
  mutate(
    from = name[c(1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4)],
    to = name[c(3, 4, 5, 3, 6, 6)],
    weight = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2)
  )
knitr::kable(df)
```

```{r chart-helper}
create_hc <- function(t) {
  polar <- startsWith(t, "polar")
  type <- sub("^polar", "", t)
  ranges <- c(
    "arearange",
    "areasplinerange",
    "columnrange",
    "errorbar",
    "dumbbell"
  )
  links <- c(
    "sankey",
    "dependencywheel",
    "arcdiagram",
    "organization",
    "networkgraph"
  )
  points <- df |> select(x, y, name, color)
  if (type %in% ranges) {
    points <- df |> select(x, low, high, name, color)
  }
  if (type %in% c("bubble", "scatter3d", "variwide", "variablepie")) {
    points <- df |> transmute(x, y, z = abs(z) + 1, name, color)
  }
  if (type %in% c("treemap", "packedbubble")) {
    points <- df |> select(name, value, color)
  }
  if (type %in% links) {
    points <- df |> select(from, to, weight)
  }
  if (type == "wordcloud") {
    points <- df |> transmute(name, weight = value, color)
  }
  if (type == "item") {
    points <- df |> transmute(name, y = round(y), color)
  }
  if (type == "timeline") {
    points <- df |> transmute(x, name, label, description = name, color)
  }
  if (type == "bullet") {
    points <- df |> transmute(x, y, target = y + 5, color)
  }
  if (type == "vector") {
    points <- df |> transmute(x, y, length = value, direction = x * 60, color)
  }
  if (type == "windbarb") {
    points <- df |> transmute(x, value, direction = x * 60, color)
  }
  if (type == "boxplot") {
    points <- df |>
      transmute(x, low, q1 = y - 1, median = y, q3 = y + 1, high, color)
  }
  if (type %in% c("heatmap", "tilemap", "contour")) {
    points <- expand.grid(x = 0:5, y = 0:5) |>
      mutate(value = round(sin(x) + cos(y), 2))
  }
  if (type %in% c("sunburst", "treegraph")) {
    points <- bind_rows(
      tibble(id = "fruit", name = "Fruit", color = colors[1]),
      df |> transmute(id = name, parent = "fruit", name, value, color)
    )
  }
  single_color <- type %in%
    c("line", "spline", "area", "areaspline", "streamgraph")
  if (single_color) {
    points$color <- NULL
  }
  hc <- highchart() |>
    hc_chart(
      type = type,
      polar = polar,
      inverted = type %in% c("dumbbell", "organization")
    ) |>
    hc_title(text = t, style = list(fontSize = "16px")) |>
    hc_colors(colors) |>
    hc_xAxis(categories = df$name) |>
    hc_yAxis(visible = !type %in% c("streamgraph", "timeline")) |>
    hc_add_series(
      data = list_parse(points),
      type = type,
      name = "Fruit consumption",
      color = if (single_color) "#7CB5EC",
      colorByPoint = !single_color,
      showInLegend = FALSE
    ) |>
    hc_tooltip(outside = TRUE) |>
    hc_size(height = 300)
  if (type %in% c("scatter3d", "cylinder", "funnel3d", "pyramid3d")) {
    hc <- hc |>
      hc_chart(
        options3d = list(enabled = TRUE, alpha = 15, beta = 15, depth = 50)
      )
  }
  if (type %in% c("heatmap", "tilemap", "contour")) {
    hc <- hc |>
      hc_colorAxis(stops = color_stops(colors = colors2), min = -2, max = 2)
  }
  hc
}
```

## Task intervals

Each row spans two dates. Map the start to `x`, the end to `x2` and the lane's zero-based index to `y`.

```{r mapping-xrange}
tasks <- data.frame(
  start = base::as.Date(c("2025-01-06", "2025-01-08")),
  finish = base::as.Date(c("2025-01-09", "2025-01-13")),
  lane = 0:1
)
hchart(tasks, "xrange", hcaes(x = start, x2 = finish, y = lane)) |>
  hc_yAxis(categories = c("Design", "Review"))
```

## Five-number summaries

Each row supplies the two whisker ends, the lower and upper quartiles, and the median for one box.

```{r mapping-boxplot}
waits <- data.frame(
  clinic = c("North", "South"),
  lower = c(4, 6),
  p25 = c(6, 8),
  p50 = c(10, 12),
  p75 = c(14, 15),
  upper = c(19, 22)
)
hchart(
  waits,
  "boxplot",
  hcaes(x = clinic, low = lower, q1 = p25, median = p50, q3 = p75, high = upper)
)
```

## Map links between nodes

Each row describes a link. Map its two node IDs to `from` and `to`. The
series type determines what you can read from those links.

| What you want to show | Series | Point fields |
|---|---|---|
| Which nodes are connected | `networkgraph` | `from`, `to` |
| How much flows between them | `sankey`, `dependencywheel`, `arcdiagram` | `from`, `to`, `weight` |
| Who reports to whom | `organization` | `from` (parent), `to` (child) |

These trips connect two districts to two transport modes. In the Sankey
diagram, the width of each link shows how many passengers took that route.

```{r mapping-sankey}
trips <- data.frame(
  origin = c("North", "North", "South"),
  destination = c("Bus", "Rail", "Rail"),
  passengers = c(30, 20, 15)
)
hchart(
  trips,
  "sankey",
  hcaes(from = origin, to = destination, weight = passengers)
)
```

## Style network nodes and tooltips

Rail serves both districts. To show those connections, reuse the trip table
as the links of a `networkgraph`. Style the endpoints separately in `nodes`,
matching each `id` to a value in `from` or `to`. Here blue identifies districts
and orange identifies transport modes. Circle area is proportional to the
passenger total at each node.

```{r mapping-networkgraph}
passengers <- tapply(
  rep(trips$passengers, 2),
  c(trips$origin, trips$destination),
  sum
)
nodes <- lapply(names(passengers), function(id) {
  n <- passengers[[id]]
  district <- id %in% trips$origin
  list(
    id = id,
    name = if (district) paste(id, "district") else id,
    color = if (district) "#386B9E" else "#BD6333",
    marker = list(radius = 2 * sqrt(n)),
    custom = list(passengers = n)
  )
})

hchart(
  trips,
  "networkgraph",
  hcaes(from = origin, to = destination),
  nodes = nodes,
  dataLabels = list(enabled = TRUE, format = "{point.name}", linkFormat = ""),
  tooltip = list(
    headerFormat = "",
    nodeFormat = "<b>{point.name}</b><br>Passengers: {point.custom.passengers}"
  )
)
```

`dataLabels.format` shows the node name on the chart. `tooltip.nodeFormat`
adds detail on hover. Hover over Rail to see 35 passengers, 20 from North
and 15 from South.

If you already have an `igraph` object, `hchart(graph, layout = igraph::layout_with_fr)`
uses the layout calculated in R and carries node attributes into the chart.


## Specialized chart recipes

Some charts need their own data shape. These examples include weighted arcs,
unit symbols, fields and timelines, with the R code beside each result.

```{r specialized-recipes, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
recipes <- c(
  "arcdiagram",
  "item",
  "wordcloud",
  "tilemap",
  "vector",
  "venn",
  "solidgauge"
)
for (name in recipes) {
  path <- here::here("dev", "examples-charts", paste0(name, ".R"))
  cat(knitr::spin_child(path), sep = "\n")
}
```

See [Icons and pictograms](icons-and-pictograms.html) for image markers,
icons in tooltips and symbols that represent individual items.
